<jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
                     </jats:title><jats:p>We study the 3<jats:italic>d</jats:italic><jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ \mathcal{N} $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mi>N</mml:mi>
                </mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula> = 2 theories resulting from the compactification of a family of 5<jats:italic>d</jats:italic> SCFTs on a torus with flux in the global symmetry. The family of 5<jats:italic>d</jats:italic> SCFTs used in the analysis is the one that UV completes the 5<jats:italic>d</jats:italic> SU(<jats:italic>N</jats:italic> + 1) gauge theories with Chern-Simons level <jats:italic>k</jats:italic> and <jats:italic>N</jats:italic><jats:sub><jats:italic>f</jats:italic></jats:sub> fundamental hypermultiplets, generalizing the previous investigation of the torus compactifications of the rank 1 Seiberg <jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ {E}_{N_{f+1}} $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:msub>
                    <mml:mi>E</mml:mi>
                    <mml:msub>
                      <mml:mi>N</mml:mi>
                      <mml:mrow>
                        <mml:mi>f</mml:mi>
                        <mml:mo>+</mml:mo>
                        <mml:mn>1</mml:mn>
                      </mml:mrow>
                    </mml:msub>
                  </mml:msub>
                </mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula> SCFT (which is the <jats:italic>N</jats:italic> = 1 member of the family). This construction systematically yields three-dimensional theories presenting highly non-trivial non-perturbative phenomena such as infra-red dualities and enhanced symmetries, which we check using various methods.</jats:p>
title: On the 3d compactifications of 5d SCFTs associated with SU(N + 1) gauge theories
